title: Ashgrove Atelier
text:
Ashgrove Atelier

['2026-01-20 - inbound signup via landing page (self-serve). created trial, first key provisioned.', '2026-02-03 - onboarding email sequence; customer opened docs but low usage (≈300 tokens total in first 2 weeks).', "2026-02-10 - quick sync w/ dev lead (Fireflies ff-20260210). dev: 'we spun OpenAI key first — latency good but cost unclear for our recommendations flow.'", '2026-02-18 - AE intro call (Maya) — qualified pain: reduce support agent TTR, automated product suggestions on PDP. want hosted (public cloud) to avoid ops overhead.', '2026-02-25 - dev reported attempt to run batch embed job but stopped due to billing alert; trial card hit limit. only 2 endpoints exercised (chat + embeddings).', "2026-03-01 - demo scheduled but customer rescheduled to evaluate competitor PoC (Anthropic). noted: 'pricing per token hard to predict with our 3M monthly pageviews'", '2026-03-01 - recorded call (ff-20260301-ashgrove-trial-1032) — SE asked for example token burn for 3 SKU recommendations per session; customer wants 95th percentile latency < 250ms.', 'Security/compliance: SMB — SOC2 desired but not blocker. needs audit_logging and basic retention controls. no SSO required now.', 'Technical constraints: public cloud okay, single-region NA preferred. throughput target: 50 rps peak (bursty), P95 latency target 200-300ms for chat rerank path.', 'Current adoption: stalled after initial key — unclear if keys rotated. low API calls after early tests. likely churn risk (trial at-risk).', "Competitive signals: running parallel PoC on OpenAI and Anthropic, comparing latency & price. quoted Redwood's batch/kv cache benefits but customer didn't have infra time to test advanced features.", 'Action items (AE/SE): 1) share concrete token cost scenarios for 3-recs funnel (attached deck), 2) provide quickstart example for caching + batching in under 30min, 3) offer to shorten demo to targeted P95 measurement session.', "Customer quote (paraphrase): 'We want predictable monthly spend — give us a baseline and a clear saving path vs OpenAI.'", 'Next steps: send tailored cost projection + 2 sample prompt templates; propose 30-min P95 latency review with SE (Liam). follow up by 2026-03-12.']
